mapgen019_statement: continuity_status = CONTINUOUS on all six frontiers, confidence HIGH on five
defect: A single column was doing two jobs. 'Nothing was ceded' and 'the drawn line may be used as a boundary authority at 6 km' are different claims, and MAPGEN-019 proved only the first.
correction: Split into territorial_political_continuity and boundary_position_continuity, additive columns on the same audit CSV. No schema version change.
effect: Political continuity survives unchanged on every frontier. Boundary-position continuity is now CONFIRMED only away from four local cases, each of which is subsegmented.

mapgen019_statement: seg_swedish_pomerania listed as one of six Brandenburg frontiers, CONTINUOUS/HIGH
defect: Brandenburg did not border Swedish Pomerania in 1756. The Treaty of Stockholm (1720) had already moved the Swedish line north of the Peene.
correction: seg_swedish_pomerania reclassified NOT_APPLICABLE; the real northern frontier, Uckermark against PRUSSIAN Pomerania, is recorded as seg_prussian_pomerania and carries the Gartz/Vierraden evidence.
effect: Six segments become six again, but one of them is a different frontier from the one MAPGEN-019 named.

defect: A single Feldmark under regulation would otherwise force a whole frontier to UNRESOLVED.

effect: Four local cases are quarantined; the remainders stay usable.
